data.body: Research R16b7d15f12. Problem: CHANGELOG/RESEARCH/README and regenerated files are touched by every item, so leases collide (claims refused) or agents commit them unleased and the hook warning becomes noise; real conflicts then surface only at merge. Options: (A, recommended) [lease].shared_globs = [...] (default empty): a path matching it is exempt from glob_clash between leases (claim, update, wait, plan), and the commit hook counts it covered for any live lease holder; 'ddflow adopt'/doctor offers a 'merge=union' .gitattributes line for each shared glob that is append-only (git probe: two CHANGELOG prepends merge cleanly), and doctor WARNS for a shared glob with no merge driver (a generated file must be regenerated at merge, not unioned -- union interleaves). (B) a per-item 'append' glob prefix (e.g. '+docs/CHANGELOG.md') meaning shared for this claim only -- more flexible, but every agent must remember it and one forgetting it still collides. (C) status quo + docs: keep these files out of item globs and have the merge step (or one owner item) write them -- no code, but CHANGELOG entries are lost or serialised. Second half of the bug, independent of the choice: the pre-commit lease check should ignore paths whose staged content equals the base branch's (a merge-from-main commit listed main's already-merged paths as unleased) -- that one is a plain bug fix in services/enforce.py and can be split out. Needs: operator picks A/B/C (and whether merge=union is written automatically or only advised).

data.summary: A heartbeat that revives a lapsed lease catches up its globs but not its resources: update --resources made while the lease had lapsed reaches item.resources only (plan_retarget leaves an expired lease alone), and api/lifecycle._catch_up_globs re-syncs globs only, so a raised reservation stays under-counted by resource_shortfall. Fixing it needs claim --resources to write item.resources too (else the catch-up would undo a claim-time override, as Bbd07ab69fd does for globs). Found by roborev job 895 on a7514d8 (B-update-resources-lease); deferred to the claim-globs task because api/lifecycle.py is held elsewhere.

data.body: Research Rad6c6903f7, Rc6d9f0349e, Rbed6d1eead. (1) cli.py: --globs on claim/update/task add/phase add/split accumulates every value (repeated flag), each read by core/globspec.parse (comma list or JSON array). (2) globspec.problem refuses a glob carrying a double quote, an edge single quote or an unbalanced '[' -- leases.acquire raises LeaseError (claim exit 3, nothing recorded), items add/update refuse. (3) leases.acquire / _renew_in_place: globs a claim names that differ from the item's stored globs are appended as <kind>.updated in the same transaction, so the item and lease agree and heartbeat's catch-up (Bb21d338f26), whether live or reviving a lapsed lease (Bc5aec031b3), cannot reset them. (4) update --globs keeps REPLACE semantics (field set; the implement gate text says so since B-fix-bad-mentions) and reports globs_dropped; the CLI prints them. (5) show prints lease globs when they differ from the item's. Follow-up (api/lifecycle.py, held by B-fix-merge-report): api claim parses JSON itself for MCP, claim prints the recorded globs, wait --globs (B7036cf788c), heartbeat catches up resources (B7f8060f2f5).

data.body: Research Rad6c6903f7, Rbed6d1eead, R0b76d41798, roborev 895 (B7f8060f2f5). Builds on B-fix-claim-globs (core/globspec, claim records item globs). (1) cli.py: --globs on claim/update/task add/phase add/split is repeatable (every value kept, each read by globspec). (2) api claim parses globs with globspec (a JSON array from MCP read whole), and returns the recorded globs; cmd_claim prints them. (3) update --globs keeps REPLACE semantics (a field set, as the implement gate text says since B-fix-bad-mentions); the api returns globs_dropped for a claimed item and the CLI prints them; driver text (docs + template) says 'every glob, old and new -- it replaces the list'. (4) show prints the lease's globs when they differ from the item's. (5) wait --item accepts --globs (claim's parser) and judges glob_clash on them. (6) claim --resources records item.resources like globs, and heartbeat's catch-up includes resources through plan_retarget's capacity check. Files are held by B-fix-merge-report / B-fix-global-opts-anywhere / B-fix-board-json right now; claim when they release.
